item.title: Two arrested over aggravated robbery in Suva
item.description: Totogo Police have arrested the two men alleged to be involved in an aggravated robbery in Suva. The two are alleged to have entered a shop and stolen a school bag belonging to the victim’s daughter. The two were arrested last night and taken into custody, where they are currently being questioned.
